title: Kummer class transport through normalized scalar endpoints
statement: For normalized endpoints e on the projective line and an invertible N, the underlying additive map of the normalized line insertion sends the ordinary finite Kummer class of O(1) over A to the corresponding class over B.

proof.text: Evaluate the normalized line insertion on pure Tate-line generators. The equation e.line_normalization identifies the inserted root map with the B root map. Functoriality of the Kummer connecting class and of Sheaf.H.map then gives the stated equality.

lean.statement:
theorem p1KummerChernScalar_kummer_transport
    {A B : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A] [CommRing B]
    {φ : A →+* B} {N : ℕ} {hA : (N : A) = 0} {hB : (N : B) = 0}
    {S : Scheme.{u}} (hP : IsUnit (N : Γ(ProjectiveLine S, ⊤)))
    (e : P1KummerScalarEndpoints φ N hA hB (ProjectiveLine S)) :
    Sheaf.H.map (p1KummerScalarForgetLineMap e) 2
        (ordinaryFiniteP1KummerClass A N hA S hP) =
      ordinaryFiniteP1KummerClass B N hB S hP
